purpose: Non-admission discovery registry of potentially useful severe-convective and hail data sources.

entries.name: MeteoSwiss National Hail Climatology Switzerland
entries.provider: Federal Office of Meteorology and Climatology MeteoSwiss
entries.temporal_scope: radar hail observations from 2002 onward with operational climatology updates
entries.resolution_or_granularity: 1 km² radar-derived POH/MESHS fields at 5-minute resolution; climatologies and HailStoRe return-period products
entries.note: Radar-generation and model changes limit temporal homogeneity; distinguish radar-derived POH/MESHS fields from HailStoRe resampled synthetic-event products and do not infer trends from the short record.

entries.name: NOAA MRMS Maximum Estimated Size of Hail (MESH)
entries.provider: NOAA National Weather Service / National Severe Storms Laboratory
entries.spatial_scope: MRMS operational domains, including CONUS and other supported U.S. domains
entries.temporal_scope: operational product with versioned MRMS processing
entries.resolution_or_granularity: 0.01 degree gridded MESH at 2-minute resolution; swath maxima available for multiple windows
entries.note: Radar/model-derived hail-size estimate in millimetres, not direct ground truth; preserve known storm-structure and temperature-profile biases plus exact MRMS version/product identity.
